description: Get a one-time upload address for a file in the agent file store — NEVER send file content as base64 through a tool. Required: name (e.g. bericht.pdf). Upload the raw bytes with PUT (curl -X PUT --data-binary @file -H 'Content-Type: …' '<upload_url>'), then pass the returned path to upload_remote_file (put it into Google Drive/OneDrive/Dropbox/ownCloud) or get_file_link (a link to share). Valid 2 hours.
name: create_file_upload_url
